setting.heading: On North Parade
setting.lead: Sotto Sotto is on North Parade.

fact.text: North Parade is a historic Georgian street and promenade in central Bath, designed by John Wood the Elder in 1741, built in honey-coloured Bath stone, with views over the River Avon and Parade Gardens.
fact.source: Google summary supplied by the client, 2026-11-14
